modmenu.summaryTranslation.brilliant-ser: Client companion for the Brilliant server: Discord Rich Presence, minimap and world map, Discord-style emoji and sticker picker, searchable chat menu, channel tabs, PM window, automation scripts, freecam, shulker box preview, and more.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.brilliant:
The official client companion for the Brilliant server (brilliantw.net).

• Discord Rich Presence with sub-server and play time
• Searchable chat menu: announcements, articles, chat history, quick messages, custom commands, coordinate sharing, and sponsorship
• Channel tabs, a private message window, and chat replies
• Discord-style emoji and sticker picker; animated emojis and stickers play in chat; HD in-game viewer for Discord image links
• Minimap and world map with residences, public homes, regenerating chunks, slime chunks, and waypoints; switches to a cave map underground
• Scratch-style automation scripts with a template library, debugger, and Discord Webhook blocks
• Freecam, night vision, and distant chunk retention (optionally saved to disk to see past the server view distance)
• Shulker box preview with a slot grid; hold Shift to pin it and inspect each item
• Key bindings for custom commands, including mouse side buttons and Ctrl / Alt / Shift combos
• Command aliases and TAB completion
• Auto reconnect and auto re-authentication, with login synced to the Brilliant Launcher
• Color preview, recipe book fix, slot numbers, full anvil cost, custom scoreboard position
• Custom accent color and background tone
• In-game update notices with one-click update

Most features are only active on brilliantw.net.
